events.title: Iran War Escalation

events.reasoning: The escalating conflict in Iran is likely to lead to increased volatility in the markets, with potential for oil price shocks and wider geopolitical instability. The SPDR S&P 500 ETF Trust (SPY) may benefit from safe-haven flows, while the iShares 20+ Year Treasury Bond ETF (TLT) may be negatively affected by rising interest rates and inflation concerns.
